entities.summary: Loutraki is a seaside resort town on the Gulf of Corinth, in Corinthia, Greece. It is located 81 kilometres west of Athens and 8 kilometres northeast of Corinth. Loutraki is the seat of the municipality Loutraki-Perachora-Agioi Theodoroi. The town is known for its vast natural springs and its therapeutic spas. It is a popular tourist destination for its crystal clear waters. The Casino of Loutraki has thousands of visitors every day. According to the 2021 census, it has a population of 12,212.
